title: FDA awaits replies from restaurants at MCA premises: Tukaram Mundhe
summary: Maharashtra’s Food and Drug Administration has issued notices to five restaurants at the Mumbai Cricket Association’s Bandra-Kurla Complex premises over alleged violations involving third-party operators, FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe said

title: ACB raids Nellore toll plaza: ₹68,000 found by the roadside, ₹1.70 lakh in a car boot
summary: Officers find ₹68,000 lying by the road and ₹1.70 lakh in the boot of a motor vehicle inspector’s car; the ACB says he was collecting money from drivers with the help of two home guards and a private driver

title: Former UDP MLA Jemino Mawthoh to join BJP on September 12
summary: Former Meghalaya MLA Jemino Mawthoh announced that he and his supporters will join the BJP on September 12, months after he resigned from the United Democratic Party (UDP)

title: Manipur: 2 militants killed, 2 injured in joint operations by Army-Assam Rifles
summary: The forces established surveillance over a UKNA camp and commenced tactical closing-in at 5 am on September 2, they said

title: Popularity was never my goal; what matters is public health: Tukaram Mundhe
summary: “We cannot become a superpower if our human resources are not healthy,” Tukaram Mundhe says

title: Tamil Nadu failing at animal birth control
summary: The abject failure of the Animal Birth Control programme in the State is apparent on the streets. This report reveals that the ABC programme, besides being in a shambles, is inhumane, corrupt, and cruel, in many cases

title: Regime suppressing youth will have to answer to the people, says Rahul Gandhi
summary: After meeting Bihar youth, Mr. Gandhi accuses Bihar police of “horrific brutality” using lathis, firearms against student protesters

title: ISRO staff bodies seek clarification on the trajectory of privatisation
summary: It raised several other concerns. These include whether the design, development, realisation, integration, testing and launch of PSLV, LVM3, SSLV and successor vehicles will continue as ISRO functions or will cease.
